Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class WikiContradictionEntity

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.WikiContradictionEntity
@Entity public class WikiContradictionEntity extends Object
JPA entity representing a detected contradiction in the wiki_contradictions table.

Stores the prior and new claims along with pipe-delimited article IDs for provenance on both sides. This matches the project's existing pattern for multi-value storage (see EvaluationResultEntity).
